advancements.expresscarts.root.title: Express Carts
advancements.expresscarts.root.descripti: Faster minecarts! Combine a Minecart with a Redstone Torch for an Express Minecart, or a Minecart with Chest and a Redstone Torch for an Express Chest Minecart.

advancements.expresscarts.express_long_r: Ride an Express Minecart for over 10,000 blocks in one trip

expresscarts.config.comment.maxMinecartS: Base maximum speed of Express Minecarts, in blocks per second.
expresscarts.config.comment.waterSpeedMu: Multiplier to the maximum Express Minecart speed when in water.
expresscarts.config.comment.brakingEnabl: Whether players may hold the backwards movement key to brake.
expresscarts.config.comment.brakeSlowdow: Amount by which an Express Minecart's velocity is scaled each tick its passenger holds the brakes.
expresscarts.config.comment.blockSpeedMu: Max speed multipliers when the rails are on certain blocks.
expresscarts.config.comment.fastUnpowere: Stop faster on unpowered powered rails.
expresscarts.config.comment.loadChunks: Whether Express Minecarts will load chunks around themselves.
expresscarts.config.comment.fallDamageMu: Fall damage multiplier for an Express Minecart's passengers.
expresscarts.config.comment.chestMaxMine: Base maximum speed of Express Chest Minecarts, in blocks per second.
expresscarts.config.comment.chestWaterSp: Multiplier to the maximum Express Chest Minecart speed when in water.
expresscarts.config.comment.chestBraking: Whether a rider may hold the backwards movement key to brake an Express Chest Minecart.
expresscarts.config.comment.chestBrakeSl: Amount by which an Express Chest Minecart's velocity is scaled each tick its rider holds the brakes.
expresscarts.config.comment.chestBlockSp: Max speed multipliers for Express Chest Minecarts when the rails are on certain blocks.
expresscarts.config.comment.chestFastUnp: Stop Express Chest Minecarts faster on unpowered powered rails.
expresscarts.config.comment.chestLoadChu: Whether Express Chest Minecarts will load chunks around themselves.
